# networking-hosts

## networking.hosts

Static host entries, kept in a marked block of `/etc/hosts`. Lines
outside the block are left alone, and the block is removed when no
entries are declared.

*Type:*
attribute set of list of string

*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```

*Example:*

```nix
{
  "192.168.0.2" = [
    "fileserver.local"
    "nameserver.local"
  ];
}
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/networking/hosts/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/networking/hosts/default.nix)
